title: Frontend: Transfer List
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Transfer List. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({initialLeft=[A,B,C],initialRight=[]}). Render lists [data-testid=left/right] with checkboxes[data-check=LABEL]. Buttons Move right/Move left transfer checked eligible rows in original list order, clear selection, and retain all unselected rows. Outputs [data-testid=left-order/right-order] are comma-joined. Labels are globally unique.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use stable IDs and two membership collections, plus a set of checked IDs.
alternativeApproaches: Add per-list search while defining whether Select all affects visible or all eligible records.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: No selection; move all; partial selection.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
